findings.message: Addressing: Incompatible terrain, foliage, architecture, character, and prop material languages
findings.action: Apply unified Choyce color palette (#D4C4A8, #8FA68A, #B8D8D8, #8B6B51, #A66B5A, #E8A862) to all materials in opening scene

findings.message: Addressing: Overlapping fixed-height route planes pasted onto terrain
findings.action: Replace fixed-height planes with terrain-conforming mesh paths using PCG3D or manual sculpting. Remove duplicate geometry layers.

findings.message: Addressing: Bridge approaches and rectangular river/bank presentation insufficiently authored
findings.action: Replace primitive bridge geometry with authored bridge model from Kenney Nature Pack. Add proper bank shading, erosion textures, and pebble/sand transition materials. Ensure bridge rails have collision.

findings.message: Addressing: Bridge reads as primitive deck geometry with disconnected stair chunks
findings.action: Import Kenney bridge model (bridgeWood.glb) with proper deck, rails, and support beams. Connect stairs with smooth transitions. Add wood material with correct PBR values (metallic: 0.0, roughness: 0.6).

findings.message: Addressing: 2.3km water surface has insufficient mesh density for wave frequency
findings.action: Increase water mesh subdivision to 256x256. Apply proper normal map for wave detail. Adjust wave scale and speed parameters for convincing water movement.

findings.message: Addressing: Water surface lacks convincing shore/depth treatment
findings.action: Add shore gradient: shallow (#D0E8E8) -> medium (#B8D8D8) -> deep (#8AABA8). Implement foam particles at shore edges. Add subtle depth fog under water.

findings.message: Addressing: Vegetation scale/density insufficient for child-facing opening
findings.action: Increase tree scale to 1.5x-2.0x. Use Kenney Nature Pack trees with proper LOD. Add underbrush clusters. Implement density gradient (dense near paths, sparse at edges).
Enable contact shadows for all props. Add small ground displacement under objects. Implement ambient occlusion bake for static props.

findings.message: Addressing: Persistent HUD chrome visible in opening
findings.action: Hide HUD elements during opening cinematic. Implement fade-in after player control begins. Remove debug text overlays.

findings.message: Addressing: First-action affordance not readable for children
findings.action: Add glowing interaction prompt for first action. Implement hand icon cursor change on hover. Add subtle pulsing animation to interactable objects.

findings.message: Addressing: Missing bidirectional player traversal validation for bridge
findings.action: Create automated test: player walks from bank A to bank B, verifies dry deck, checks rail collision, confirms bidirectionality.

findings.message: Addressing: Path overlays use hard-edged fixed-height planes breaking at bridge approaches
findings.action: Replace path planes with decal-based or mesh-based paths that conform to terrain. Use soft-edge textures with alpha blending.
